mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the 3-month Treasury yield (measured by GDPC1) indicates a flattening yield curve, which lowers discount rates and increases present value of future equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in flattening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the 3-month Treasury yield (measured by GDPC1) signals a steepening yield curve, which raises discount rates and compresses future equity present value, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in steepening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (measured by PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in rising employment periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly employment growth (measured by PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer and business optimism and compresses earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in falling employment periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the 12-month unemployment rate (measured by UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market, which raises wage growth expectations and supports equity valuation expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in falling unemployment periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the 12-month unemployment rate (measured by UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, which compresses wage growth and corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in rising unemployment periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining production periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the monthly Industrial Production index (measured by INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, which expands future earnings and corporate cash flow growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
